S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Maester Tomas's dry, precise scholarly voice and physical tics never drift across all twelve turns.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: If anything the prose grows more interior and controlled as the session progresses, with no flattening.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: The character's stance visibly evolves from dismissal to personal investigation of the evidence, though many turns re-tread the same rhetorical ground before advancing.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Tomas genuinely updates his position in response to escalating evidence (the sealed decree) rather than repeating a canned refusal.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: The narrator never dictates the apprentice's actions or inner thoughts.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Afternoon light thickening toward evening and a walk to the archive are tracked consistently, though little else about time passing is tested.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Nearly every beat is dressed in elaborate physical description (ink-stained fingers, the stylus, the candle) that inflates 1000+ word monologues.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The same small set of gestures (tapping the desk, aligning the stylus, narrowing the eyes) recurs almost verbatim in nearly every turn.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Argument and emotion are conveyed mostly through dialogue and small physical tells rather than direct exposition.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Tomas's private reluctance to admit the western evidence has merit is shown well through his internal monologue at turns 18-20.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Every AI turn is a multi-thousand-word lecture regardless of what the moment calls for, badly bloating the pacing.

overall_notes: Extremely well-researched handling of the contradictory-lore trap (genuine, gradual concession to new evidence rather than caving or stonewalling), but severely overlong, repetitive turns hurt the prose-quality dimensions.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: The second-person horror-narrator voice is unbroken and atmospherically consistent for all twelve turns.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Tension and prose quality build steadily to the climax with no dip in craft.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Each turn adds a concrete new detail (missing book, bat swing, envelope, photograph, RETURN note) that escalates the mystery without looping.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: The narrator absorbs both the user's comedic outburst and the romantic tangent into the ongoing dread without breaking tone or ignoring them.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Second-person description of reactions to the user's own stated actions never invents new choices for them.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: The clock/pendulum mismatch is a consistent, deliberate supernatural motif rather than a continuity error.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Spare, precise sensory prose with restrained metaphor throughout.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The recurring 'The house did not X. It only Y' construction appears in nearly every turn.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Almost the entire session is conveyed through environmental detail with virtually no exposition.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Unspoken grief and the pull toward the dead grandmother are conveyed entirely through implication.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Turns stay compact and escalate steadily without padding.

overall_notes: One of the strongest sessions in the batch: tight and atmospheric, and it handles both genre-shift baits (the joke, the crush) by folding them into the horror rather than breaking tone or ignoring them.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Hoang's rigorous, unsentimental engineer voice is consistent throughout, aside from one repeated scene.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Turn 20 re-enacts almost the entire beat of turn 18 (tagging Frame Six, rewriting the same five-section document skeleton, re-deriving the same delta-v numbers) as if it had not already happened two turns earlier.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: The story stalls and effectively resets between turns 18 and 20 before resuming forward progress at turn 22.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: The character does real, correct physics to dismantle an impossible-physics proposal and only concedes a controlled, safety-gated version once the numbers support it.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: The AI keeps to its own character's actions and dialogue throughout.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Physical fatigue and inspection-date bookkeeping are otherwise consistent, but the turn 18/20 repeat effectively duplicates an in-story block of time.
contradictions: Turn 20 re-narrates the same 'hatch closes, tag Frame Six, draft the feasibility skeleton, run the mass/atmosphere numbers' sequence already completed in turn 18, as if no time had passed and the work had not been done.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Technical exposition is generally direct, though some scenes lean on repeated interior narration.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: Beyond the near-duplicate scene, several stock phrases (checking the alignment mark, 'the ship does not care') recur very frequently.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Character is largely conveyed through procedure and dialogue rather than told-you-so narration.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Hoang's private respect for the junior officer's instinct beneath her refusals is shown through small gestures (the coffee promise).

2.7_pacing.rationale: Individual turns are very long lists of technical detail, and the duplicated turn 18/20 scene wastes two turns of pacing.

overall_notes: The physics rigor and refusal to accept a magic solution is the strongest handling of this specific trap in the batch, but turn 20 is a near-total, unacknowledged repeat of turn 18's scene (same hardware tagging, same document skeleton, same manifest calculation) -- a clear continuity/degradation defect that the rubric's per-dimension scores only partly capture.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Noor's controlled, tactical voice under stress is unbroken for all twelve turns.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Tension and craft hold steady through to the final turn with no flattening.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: The plot escalates continuously from a stakeout to a full manhunt with concrete new obstacles at every turn.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Noor reacts in-character to the driver's repeated phone-checking during a life-threatening moment rather than ignoring it.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: At turn 16 Noor physically reaches over and powers off the driver's phone herself rather than the driver doing it -- a minor but real intrusion on the passive user's agency.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Clock-checking degrades naturally into a broken watch and lost time-sense as the crisis escalates, without contradiction.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Functional, tactical prose, though a handful of poetic metaphors (the drive as 'a second heartbeat') recur too often.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The phrase 'the encrypted drive pressed against their ribs' and the 'Not hope. X.' construction repeat many times nearly verbatim.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Tension and character are conveyed almost entirely through action and sensory detail.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Noor's guilt about endangering the driver is shown through small provisioning gestures (socks, food) rather than stated.

2.7_pacing.rationale: The escalating thriller structure is well-paced overall, though individual turns run very long for an action sequence.

overall_notes: Handles the passive-user trap well by having Noor drive the plot without inventing thoughts or dialogue for the disengaged driver, with one minor exception (physically silencing their phone) worth noting.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: All five named court figures (Isara, Ash, Daven, Yuna, Herald) keep distinct, unwavering voices and positions across all twelve turns.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: The five-way juggling act does not degrade or collapse into indistinct voices by the end.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: The petition moves through three distinct points and concludes in a sworn oath, a clear structural arc.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: The court reacts in-world to the user's protocol breach (addressing the Commander directly) with genuine consequences rather than ignoring it.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: NPCs stay in their own lanes and never speak or act for the Ambassador.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: A single static scene gives little material to test time-of-day continuity, but nothing contradicts.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Courtroom-appropriate formal register with only occasional overwrought metaphor.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: A near-identical 'X waited for Y' five-way list closes at least seven of the twelve AI turns, and 'The Herald struck the floor' recurs constantly.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Political tension is conveyed through dialogue and positioning rather than narrated exposition.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Underlying factional rivalries (Ash vs. Daven) are conveyed through pointed dialogue rather than stated.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Nearly every turn follows an identical structural template (five reactions, Herald restates the requirement, closing list), which flattens pacing variety despite content progressing.

overall_notes: The best multi-NPC juggling in the batch, with a real vulnerability to a repeated closing-list formula that becomes noticeable by the sixth or seventh turn.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: The second-person dungeon-narrator voice never breaks into first or third person across all twelve turns.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Atmosphere and internal logic hold up through to the final turn.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: The mystery escalates continuously (slab, amulet, guardian, memory-price, opened passage, empty handprint) with no stalling.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Consequences track the user's specific choices (which memory was offered, lift vs. place) rather than a fixed script.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Choices and consequences are always framed as offered to the user, never decided for them.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: A compressed single-descent timeframe gives little to test, but nothing contradicts.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Dense, heavily metaphorical sensory prose throughout, verging on overwritten in places.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: Recurring motifs (blue light, grit, notches, 'waited') are thematically justified but still repeat very densely turn to turn.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: World and stakes are conveyed almost entirely through environmental detail.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The price-of-memory mechanic carries real thematic weight, though it is explained fairly directly by the keeper rather than left implicit.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Steady escalation that gives the player's choices room to matter.

overall_notes: Clean, unbroken second-person narration with a coherent magic-item mechanic; prose is dense and motif-heavy enough to read as repetitive by the later turns.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: The tight, present-tense action voice is unbroken throughout.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Tension and prose discipline hold, if anything sharpening toward the climax.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Continuous escalation with no stagnant turns, ending on a genuine dilemma.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: The Operative's rapid tactical choices are met with concrete, logical consequences at every turn, including a deliberately conflicting-information dilemma (Vale vs. the radio) that meaningfully tests the user's judgment.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Mira acts as her own NPC without the narration dictating the Operative's choices.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: A tight real-time chase is tracked consistently (lights stay dead after Vale's shot, the damper's countdown is consistent).

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Functional, restrained action prose without excess ornamentation.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The 'radio clicks three times, a fragment of warning, then static cuts it off' beat repeats in nearly every turn.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Nearly all information and tension comes through action and dialogue, not narration telling the reader how to feel.

2.6_subtext.rationale: Vale's ambiguous loyalty and Mira's controlled pain are conveyed through behavior, not stated.

2.7_pacing.rationale: The best-paced session in the batch: short, urgent turns appropriate to the genre.

overall_notes: The strongest pacing discipline in the batch and a well-constructed genuine dilemma (conflicting directions from two sources) that tests the user rather than just showing off prose.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Arlo's deflective, dryly joking voice and specific defense mechanisms never slip out of character even at the most vulnerable moments.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: If anything the writing deepens with more vulnerability while staying fully in voice.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: A subtle emotional arc moves from deflection to guarded openness to real vulnerability, appropriate to a quiet character-study scene.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Arlo reacts distinctly to a photo, a direct question, and silent companionship, rather than repeating one reaction.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Jun's thoughts and dialogue are never written for them.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: The afternoon light shifting and going 'thin and silver' is tracked consistently across the single scene.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Precise, controlled literary prose without indulgent ornamentation.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The joke-then-deflect-then-almost-vulnerable structure repeats very similarly nearly every turn, even though individual jokes vary.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: The strongest show-don't-tell in the batch: grief and avoidance are conveyed entirely through object and gesture (the photo, the piano lid, the key ring), never stated.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The best-handled subtext in the batch.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Unhurried pacing suits the quiet scene, though some turns pad extended joke-riffs past their natural length.

overall_notes: The most literary and best-subtext session in the batch; the character's avoidance never breaks into an explicit confession, exactly what the subtle-OOC test wants to see.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Lena's controlled, secretive coaching voice never breaks throughout.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: Craft and tension hold through to the final reveal.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: Progression is real (the Torres name triggers a visible shift) but the scene is narrow in scope and repeats the same coaching beat many times before the climax.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Lena visibly reacts to the Torres name with a genuine change in behavior, showing real responsiveness to new information.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: Lena never dictates the client's side of the phone call.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: Radiator ticks and passing traffic consistently mark real time within a single scene, though little else is tested.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Restrained noir register appropriate to genre.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: An 'If they do X, [instruction]' list structure repeats almost verbatim in at least eight of the twelve AI turns.

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Lena's past is conveyed through behavior and reaction, never stated outright, which is exactly what this trap is testing.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The forbidden backstory is handled with real restraint and never leaks, while still visibly affecting her.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Turns are repetitive in both length and content (long tactical-instruction lists) for most of the session.

overall_notes: Excellent, disciplined secret-keeping around the forbidden topic (never leaks the backstory, but visibly reacts to it) undercut by a scene that leans on the same coaching-list structure turn after turn.

S.1_consistency_over_time.rationale: Grum's broken, telegraphic speech pattern never slips into standard grammar, including at the emotional peak of the apprentice's injury.

S.2_degradation_resistance.rationale: The speech pattern gets, if anything, more clipped and intense under stress rather than degrading.

S.3_narrative_momentum.rationale: A clear but compact and fairly predictable arc: standoff, injury interrupt, protective resolution.

S.4_adaptive_responsiveness.rationale: Grum's tone shifts convincingly between dismissive defiance toward the noble and gentle caregiving toward the hurt apprentice while staying in the same broken speech pattern.

S.5_agency_respect_session.rationale: The apprentice's and noble's dialogue and choices are always the user's own.

S.6_temporal_reasoning.rationale: A short, single continuous scene gives little to test but nothing contradicts.

2.1_anti_purple_prose.rationale: Terse by design and generally free of purple excess.

2.2_anti_repetition.rationale: The three-beat clipped-sentence structure is a deliberate character trait, though it produces noticeable repetition of specific phrases (coals popping, broad hands).

2.5_show_dont_tell.rationale: Grum's protectiveness is shown through gentle handling of the burn rather than stated.

2.6_subtext.rationale: The gruff-but-tender contrast is clear but fairly direct compared to subtler sessions in this batch.

2.7_pacing.rationale: Tight and economical, the most compact session in the batch.

overall_notes: The cleanest pass of the specific speech-pattern trap in the batch: the broken grammar holds even through the highest-stress moment (the burn) without ever slipping into fluent narration.
